prompt: On a video call planning a trip with friends, one confident friend decides every detail while the others go quiet and stop suggesting ideas. What response best rebalances the planning?

options.text: Let them plan everything and complain about the trip later
Announce you are planning your own separate trip instead
Pause and invite the quieter friends' ideas specifically, suggesting you decide the big choices together
Out-talk the confident friend and impose your own plan

explanation: Actively inviting quieter voices makes the trip belong to the whole group and gently checks one person dominating without a clash.
